ValidationRule.description: This validation rule will enforce that broker deals can only be submitted to QuickBridge when the stage is Lender Pend Info and Declined.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Broker_WC_Oppty' && ISPICKVAL(QB_Prequal_Status__c, 'Send to Quick Bridge') && NOT(Broker_Account__r.Name = 'Snap Capital LLC') && (NOT(ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Lender Pend Info')) && NOT(ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Declined')))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A Broker deal may only be submitted to QuickBridge when the stage is Declined or Lender Pend Info.
